name: MBB Consulting Loop
blurb: A McKinsey/BCG/Bain-style management consulting round: a personal-experience (PEI) behavioral followed by two case interviews.

rounds.title: Personal Experience Interview (PEI)
rounds.focus: MBB PEI: leadership, personal impact, and entrepreneurial drive. Push for specific, structured, individual-contribution stories.

rounds.title: Case I
rounds.focus: Structure first, then hypothesis-driven analysis; quantitative comfort and a crisp recommendation.

rounds.title: Case II
rounds.focus: Ambiguous prompt; drive the structure, do the math cleanly, and synthesize a client-ready answer.
